title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
title_zh: V-JEPA Policy: 基于预测视觉潜在空间构建有效世界行动模型的简单框架

paragraphs.en: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy , a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor’s future-informed context key–value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, the same latent space supports acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge from diverse in-the-wild instruction-annotated videos. Pretraining the predictor on DROID video–instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM within our framework yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for learning effective WAMs, supporting both direct learning from task-specific demonstrations and the transfer of future-modeling knowledge acquired through predictor pretraining on broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy .

paragraphs.en: Advanced physical intelligence should endow robots with the capability not only to understand the current scene but also to anticipate how it may change through interaction. World-action models (WAMs) have thus emerged as a promising paradigm for instantiating this principle by coupling action generation with future visual-state prediction, demonstrating strong task performance and improved generalization to unfamiliar tasks and environments ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Pai et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . They highlight the value of predictive knowledge for general-purpose robot control.
paragraphs.zh: 高级物理智能应赋予机器人不仅理解当前场景，还能预判场景如何通过交互而变化的能力。 因此，世界-动作模型（WAMs）作为一种有前景的范式应运而生，它通过将动作生成与未来视觉状态预测相耦合来体现这一原则，展现出强大的任务性能以及对陌生任务和环境的更好泛化能力（Zhu et al., 2025；Pai et al., 2025；Liang et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2026；Ye et al., 2026；Bi et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 它们凸显了预测性知识对通用机器人控制的价值。

paragraphs.en: A prominent line of work acquires this capability by adapting visual generative models pretrained at scale for effective WAM learning. Video-generation models provide priors over motion and scene evolution learned from large-scale video data ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , while image-editing models provide priors over instruction-conditioned visual transformations, mapping a current observation directly to a task-specified target visual state without generating intermediate frames ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Despite these different formulations, both approaches transfer knowledge about how visual states change together with the generative backbone in which that knowledge was learned. This raises a natural question:
paragraphs.zh: 一条突出的研究路线通过将大规模预训练的视觉生成模型进行适配，以实现有效的 WAM 学习，从而获得这种能力。 视频生成模型提供了从大规模视频数据中学到的关于运动和场景演化的先验（Pai et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2026；Yuan et al., 2026），而图像编辑模型则提供了关于基于指令的视觉变换的先验，能够将当前观测直接映射到任务指定的目标视觉状态，而无需生成中间帧（Black Forest Labs, 2025；Wu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026c）。 尽管这两种表述方式不同，但二者都将关于视觉状态如何变化的知识与学习该知识的生成式主干网络一同迁移。 这引出了一个自然的问题：

sents.en: This raises a natural question:
sents.zh: 这引出了一个自然的问题：

paragraphs.en: Does effective WAM learning require inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model, or can a predictive visual latent space learned at scale provide a sufficient foundation?
paragraphs.zh: 有效的 WAM 学习是否需要继承一个完整的预训练视觉生成模型，还是在大规模下学习到的预测性视觉潜在空间就能提供足够的基础？

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy , a framework that builds a WAM on the predictive latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . We jointly learn an instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert directly from task-specific demonstrations. The predictor follows the vision transformer architecture of the V-JEPA predictor, augmented with cross-attention for instruction conditioning, and combines observed latent tokens with learnable queries at future positions to forecast future visual latents in a single forward pass. Inspired by recent foundation policies ( Black et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , our framework adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture with shared attention to combine the future predictor and the action expert. Context and future queries interact through bidirectional attention, and the resulting layer-wise context key–value states condition the action expert, allowing future modeling to directly shape action generation. V-JEPA’s large-scale video predictive self-supervised pretraining provides a visual latent space suited to this construction. With the visual encoder kept frozen and both trainable modules learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, our design directly tests whether a predictive visual latent space learned at scale can provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generator.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这一问题，我们提出 V-JEPA Policy，该框架在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器（Bardes et al., 2024；Assran et al., 2025；Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）的预测潜在空间之上构建世界动作模型（WAM）。 我们直接从任务特定的演示数据中联合学习一个以指令为条件的未来潜在预测器和一个流匹配动作专家。 该预测器遵循 V-JEPA 预测器的视觉 Transformer 架构，并增加了用于指令条件化的交叉注意力，同时将观测到的潜在 token 与未来位置上的可学习查询相结合，在单次前向传播中预测未来的视觉潜在表示。 受近期基础策略模型（Black et al., 2024；Black et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）的启发，我们的框架采用具有共享注意力的混合 Transformer（MoT）架构，将未来预测器与动作专家结合起来。 上下文与未来查询通过双向注意力进行交互，由此产生的逐层上下文键值状态作为动作专家的条件，使未来建模能够直接影响动作生成。 V-JEPA 的大规模视频预测自监督预训练提供了一个适合这种构造的视觉潜在空间。 通过保持视觉编码器冻结，并在单一下游阶段从头学习两个可训练模块，我们的设计直接检验了这样一个问题：大规模学习到的预测性视觉潜在空间能否在不继承完整预训练视觉生成器的情况下，为有效的世界动作模型学习提供充分的基础。

paragraphs.en: Beyond learning from task-specific demonstrations, we further investigate whether the same latent space can efficiently absorb general future-modeling knowledge from broad in-the-wild videos and transfer it to downstream control. Task-specific demonstrations cover only a limited range of behaviors and visual transitions. We therefore pretrain only the instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor on diverse DROID video–instruction pairs, using future-prediction supervision without action labels while keeping the V-JEPA encoder frozen ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) . We then transfer the predictor to downstream V-JEPA Policy training, where a freshly initialized flow-matching action expert is learned under the same joint objective and downstream budget. The latent space is thus tested not only as a foundation for direct WAM learning but also as a reliable substrate for acquiring and transferring more general future-modeling knowledge underlying in-the-wild videos.
paragraphs.zh: 除了从任务特定的示教数据中学习之外，我们进一步研究了同一个潜在空间能否从广泛的野外视频中高效地吸收通用的未来建模知识，并将其迁移到下游控制任务。 任务特定的示教数据仅覆盖有限范围的行为和视觉变化。 因此，我们仅在多样化的 DROID 视频–指令对上对指令条件化的未来潜在预测器进行预训练，采用未来预测监督而不使用动作标签，同时保持 V-JEPA 编码器冻结（Khazatsky et al., 2024）。 随后，我们将该预测器迁移到下游的 V-JEPA Policy 训练中，在相同的联合目标和下游预算下学习一个全新初始化的流匹配动作专家。 因此，该潜在空间不仅被验证为直接 WAM 学习的基础，还被验证为获取并迁移野外视频中更通用的未来建模知识的可靠载体。

paragraphs.en: We extensively evaluate V-JEPA Policy on both standard and distribution-shifted simulation benchmarks spanning settings from single-arm manipulation to whole-body control, as well as on a real-world dual-arm platform. Beyond comparisons with baselines, we also systematically analyze the framework through controlled studies of its visual foundation and encoder scale, context-future interaction and future-modeling supervision, training-compute scaling, and action-free predictor pretraining and transfer. With 0.9B total parameters, of which only 0.6B are trainable, the one-stage model reaches 97.25% on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) , 79.25% on LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , 50.92% on RoboCasa-GR1 tasks ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) , and 45% on two real-world multi-stage bimanual coordination tasks while remaining competitive with representative WAM and VLA baselines. Under the fixed downstream framework and training budget, the V-JEPA predictive latent outperforms the discriminative ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , reconstructive ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and video-understanding-oriented alternatives ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , with the performance gaps widening under distribution shifts. Extending downstream training compute on the same task demonstrations yields diminishing returns in generalization. Predictor-only pretraining on DROID video–instruction pairs without action label supervision instead raises LIBERO-Plus success rate from 79.25% to 91.50% at the default smaller downstream budget, remarkably surpassing the 81.64% success rate achieved by extended training. The same pretraining also raises the average real-world success rate from 45% to 80%, demonstrating the effectiveness of predictor pretraining beyond simulation. These results show that a future-latent predictor can acquire knowledge about physical world evolution from diverse in-the-wild videos and transfer it to downstream control within the same latent space.

paragraphs.en: A fixed visual space. We use the frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to encode the observed context and define the future latent targets ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . To match the encoder’s temporal tubelet size of two, we form a minimal two-frame observed context for each camera view by pairing the current frame with an earlier observation. During training, we combine this context with the corresponding future observations 𝐨 t + \mathbf{o}_{t}^{+} to form a complete video clip. Following the construction of context and target representations in V-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2025 ) , we designate its future tubelet positions as the masked region. The context path thus removes tokens at future positions before the Transformer blocks of the encoder, and encodes only observed tokens. The target path instead processes the complete unmasked clip with the same frozen encoder. We normalize its output tokens across the feature dimension and select the future positions as prediction targets. We independently encode each camera view and concatenate their context representations and future targets across views to form 𝐙 t c \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{c} and 𝐙 t + \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{+} , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 固定的视觉空间。 我们使用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器对观测上下文进行编码，并定义未来潜在目标 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) 。 为了匹配编码器的时间管片大小为 2，我们通过将当前帧与较早的观测配对，为每个相机视角构建一个最小的双帧观测上下文。 在训练期间，我们将该上下文与相应的未来观测 𝐨 t + \mathbf{o}_{t}^{+} 结合，构成完整的视频片段。 遵循 V-JEPA 中上下文与目标表示的构建方式 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) ，我们将其未来管片位置指定为掩码区域。 因此，上下文路径在编码器的 Transformer 块之前移除未来位置的词元，并仅对观测到的词元进行编码。 目标路径则使用同一个冻结编码器处理完整的未掩码片段。 我们在特征维度上对其输出词元进行归一化，并选取未来位置作为预测目标。 我们对每个相机视角独立编码，并在视角之间拼接其上下文表示与未来目标，分别形成 𝐙 t c \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{c} 和 𝐙 t + \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{+} 。

paragraphs.en: JEPA. Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn visual representations by predicting target embeddings from partial observations, progressing from image representation learning to video prediction and dense video features ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . For robot control, DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and action-conditioned V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) learn dynamics in pretrained feature spaces for planning. VLA-JEPA ( Sun et al., 2026 ) integrates latent prediction with a pretrained vision-language backbone, while JEPA-WAM ( Lin et al., 2026 ) uses a Qwen-initialized predictor with an additional vision–language alignment stage before robot-policy training. Our default framework instead jointly learns the future predictor and action expert from scratch using a frozen predictive visual encoder in a single downstream stage. We further study how this latent space supports acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge through predictor-only pretraining on in-the-wild action-free data.
paragraphs.zh: JEPA。 联合嵌入预测架构通过从部分观测预测目标嵌入来学习视觉表征，从图像表征学习逐步发展到视频预测和稠密视频特征（Assran et al., 2023; Bardes et al., 2024; Assran et al., 2025; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）。 在机器人控制方面，DINO-WM（Zhou et al., 2024）和动作条件化的 V-JEPA 2（Assran et al., 2025）在预训练特征空间中学习动力学以用于规划。 VLA-JEPA（Sun et al., 2026）将潜在预测与预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络相结合，而 JEPA-WAM（Lin et al., 2026）使用以 Qwen 初始化的预测器，并在机器人策略训练之前增加了一个额外的视觉-语言对齐阶段。 我们默认框架则不同，它在单一下游阶段中使用冻结的预测式视觉编码器，从头开始联合学习未来预测器和动作专家。 我们进一步研究该潜在空间如何通过仅在无动作的野外数据上进行预测器预训练，来支持获取可迁移的未来建模知识。

paragraphs.en: World-action models. Recent WAMs acquire predictive priors by adapting pretrained video generators or image-editing models for control ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Joint video-action modeling studies explore how visual prediction should interact with action learning ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . FastWAM further shows that future co-training can improve policy representations even when future imagination is removed at deployment ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . These approaches establish several ways to use predictive knowledge while retaining pretrained generative backbones. Our study examines the inherited visual foundation: whether the latent space learned through predictive pretraining can support effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete visual generator.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation benchmarks. We evaluate V-JEPA Policy across three simulated benchmarks and a real-world dual-arm setup: (1) LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) for in-distribution multi-task imitation across four suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, Long-Horizon); (2) LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) for out-of-distribution robustness across seven controlled shift axes (viewpoint, initial state, language, lighting, texture, noise, layout); (3) RoboCasa-GR1 ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) for humanoid manipulation across 24 tasks, extending evaluation to a distinct robot embodiment; and (4) a TianJi Marvin dual-arm platform for real-world manipulation. We report success rates throughout, with evaluation protocols detailed in Appendix A.1 .

sents.en: We evaluate V-JEPA Policy across three simulated benchmarks and a real-world dual-arm setup: (1) LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) for in-distribution multi-task imitation across four suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, Long-Horizon); (2) LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) for out-of-distribution robustness across seven controlled shift axes (viewpoint, initial state, language, lighting, texture, noise, layout); (3) RoboCasa-GR1 ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) for humanoid manipulation across 24 tasks, extending evaluation to a distinct robot embodiment; and (4) a TianJi Marvin dual-arm platform for real-world manipulation.
sents.zh: 我们在三个模拟基准和一个真实世界双臂平台上评估 V-JEPA Policy：(1) LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a )，用于四个套件（Spatial、Object、Goal、Long-Horizon）的分布内多任务模仿学习；(2) LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 )，用于七个受控偏移维度（视角、初始状态、语言、光照、纹理、噪声、布局）上的分布外鲁棒性评估；(3) RoboCasa-GR1 ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 )，用于 24 个人形操作任务，将评估扩展到一种不同的机器人本体；以及 (4) 用于真实世界操作的 TianJi Marvin 双臂平台。

sents.en: We report success rates throughout, with evaluation protocols detailed in Appendix A.1 .
sents.zh: 我们全程报告成功率，评估协议详见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. By default, V-JEPA Policy uses a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L visual encoder and a frozen T5-XXL text encoder. In the default regime, we jointly train the predictor and action expert from scratch on downstream demonstrations. We train for 10 epochs on LIBERO. On RoboCasa-GR1, we use 50k optimizer steps with a batch size of 256. The visual encoder, predictor, and action expert contain approximately 0.3B, 0.5B, and 0.1B parameters, respectively, totaling 0.9B parameters, of which 0.6B parameters are trainable. Visual-foundation comparisons and future-prediction ablations in Sec. 5.3 use a shared downstream training recipe unless stated otherwise. Network configurations and benchmark-specific training settings are detailed in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 默认情况下，V-JEPA Policy 使用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L 视觉编码器和冻结的 T5-XXL 文本编码器。 在默认设置下，我们从零开始在下游演示数据上联合训练预测器和动作专家。 我们在 LIBERO 上训练 10 个 epoch。 在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，我们使用 50k 步优化器更新，批次大小为 256。 视觉编码器、预测器和动作专家分别包含约 0.3B、0.5B 和 0.1B 参数，总计 0.9B 参数，其中 0.6B 参数可训练。 第 5.3 节中的视觉基础模型对比和未来预测消融实验，除非另有说明，均使用共享的下游训练配方。 网络配置和各基准测试的具体训练设置详见附录 A.2。

paragraphs.en: Results on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus. Table 1 summarizes the results on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus. We train on LIBERO for 10 epochs, intentionally matching the number of downstream training epochs used by FastWAM and ImageWAM. V-JEPA Policy achieves a 97.3% average success rate, remaining close to the larger generator-based WAMs and competitive with representative VLAs, which introduce additional embodied policy pre-training with action labels. paragraphs.en: Results on real-world manipulation. Finally, we test whether V-JEPA Policy remains physically feasible under real-world dynamics. On a four-view TianJi Marvin dual-arm platform, we evaluate five methods across two multi-stage manipulation tasks— Table Cleanup and Saucer Racking . As reported in Table 3 , the scratch policy succeeds on both physical tasks (55% and 35%), roughly matching generative FastWAM (60% and 35%) without requiring any visual generative pretraining. paragraphs.en: To answer Q2 , we investigate whether the choice of pretrained visual latent space influences WAM learning when the downstream prediction-control interface remains unchanged. We therefore compare frozen visual encoders while keeping the predictor and action-expert backbones, downstream demonstrations, and optimization budget fixed. To ensure a controlled comparison across heterogeneous visual foundations, we use the same raw video segments and align the resulting latent structures across encoders. Each encoder receives inputs sampled according to its native patch size and temporal compression ratio, while the resulting context latents and future prediction targets are matched in spatial grid size and temporal token length. The corresponding action chunks and labels remain identical across encoders. Encoder-specific projection layers only accommodate differences in latent feature dimensions without modifying the shared downstream WAM architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答问题2（Q2），我们研究在下游预测-控制接口保持不变的情况下，预训练视觉潜在空间的选择是否会影响WAM的学习。 因此，我们在保持预测器和动作专家骨干网络、下游演示数据以及优化预算固定不变的前提下，对冻结的视觉编码器进行比较。 为了确保跨异构视觉基础的受控比较，我们使用相同的原始视频片段，并在各编码器之间对齐所得到的潜在结构。 每个编码器接收按照其原生块大小和时间压缩率采样的输入，同时所得到的上下文潜在表示和未来预测目标在空间网格大小和时间token长度上保持匹配。 对应的动作块和标签在各编码器之间保持完全一致。 编码器专属的投影层仅用于适应潜在特征维度的差异，而不修改共享的下游WAM架构。

paragraphs.en: Comparing visual foundations. Across discriminative, reconstructive, video-understanding-oriented, and predictive representations, all evaluated encoders support downstream WAM learning, but predictive visual latents achieve the strongest overall performance under the shared recipe. V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L reaches 97.25% on LIBERO and 79.25% on LIBERO-Plus, with the advantage becoming substantially larger under distribution shifts. Compared with the strongest discriminative baseline DINOv2, the margin increases from 2.35 points in-distribution to 12.23 points under shifts. The comparison further reveals different generalization capabilities across representation families. Discriminative and video-understanding-oriented representations remain competitive on appearance-related variations, reflecting their strong sensitivity to visual semantics. In contrast, reconstructive latents exhibit substantially weaker robustness under LIBERO-Plus shifts, possibly because reconstruction objectives prioritize preserving appearance-level details that are less aligned with the object-centric and temporal abstractions required for robust control. Overall, these results suggest that predictive visual latents provide a more compatible foundation for robust WAM learning under a unified downstream interface.
paragraphs.zh: 对比各类视觉基础模型。 在判别式、重建式、面向视频理解以及预测式表征中，所有被评测的编码器都支持下游WAM学习，但在统一方案下，预测式视觉潜在表征取得了最强的整体性能。 V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L 在 LIBERO 上达到 97.25%，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 79.25%，且在分布偏移下优势显著扩大。 与最强的判别式基线 DINOv2 相比，领先幅度从分布内的 2.35 个百分点扩大到分布偏移下的 12.23 个百分点。 该对比进一步揭示了不同表征家族在泛化能力上的差异。 判别式和面向视频理解的表征在外观相关变化上仍具竞争力，反映了它们对视觉语义的强敏感性。 相比之下，重建式潜在表征在 LIBERO-Plus 偏移下表现出明显更弱的鲁棒性，这可能是因为重建目标优先保留外观层面的细节，而这些细节与鲁棒控制所需的以物体为中心和时序抽象不太一致。 总体而言，这些结果表明，预测式视觉潜在表征在统一的下游接口下为鲁棒的WAM学习提供了更兼容的基础。

sents.en: Comparing visual foundations.
sents.zh: 对比各类视觉基础模型。

sents.en: Across discriminative, reconstructive, video-understanding-oriented, and predictive representations, all evaluated encoders support downstream WAM learning, but predictive visual latents achieve the strongest overall performance under the shared recipe.
sents.zh: 在判别式、重建式、面向视频理解以及预测式表征中，所有被评测的编码器都支持下游WAM学习，但在统一方案下，预测式视觉潜在表征取得了最强的整体性能。

sents.en: V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L reaches 97.25% on LIBERO and 79.25% on LIBERO-Plus, with the advantage becoming substantially larger under distribution shifts.
sents.zh: V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L 在 LIBERO 上达到 97.25%，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 79.25%，且在分布偏移下优势显著扩大。

sents.en: Compared with the strongest discriminative baseline DINOv2, the margin increases from 2.35 points in-distribution to 12.23 points under shifts.
sents.zh: 与最强的判别式基线 DINOv2 相比，领先幅度从分布内的 2.35 个百分点扩大到分布偏移下的 12.23 个百分点。

sents.en: The comparison further reveals different generalization capabilities across representation families.
sents.zh: 该对比进一步揭示了不同表征家族在泛化能力上的差异。

sents.en: Discriminative and video-understanding-oriented representations remain competitive on appearance-related variations, reflecting their strong sensitivity to visual semantics.
sents.zh: 判别式和面向视频理解的表征在外观相关变化上仍具竞争力，反映了它们对视觉语义的强敏感性。

sents.en: In contrast, reconstructive latents exhibit substantially weaker robustness under LIBERO-Plus shifts, possibly because reconstruction objectives prioritize preserving appearance-level details that are less aligned with the object-centric and temporal abstractions required for robust control.
sents.zh: 相比之下，重建式潜在表征在 LIBERO-Plus 偏移下表现出明显更弱的鲁棒性，这可能是因为重建目标优先保留外观层面的细节，而这些细节与鲁棒控制所需的以物体为中心和时序抽象不太一致。

sents.en: Overall, these results suggest that predictive visual latents provide a more compatible foundation for robust WAM learning under a unified downstream interface.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这些结果表明，预测式视觉潜在表征在统一的下游接口下为鲁棒的WAM学习提供了更兼容的基础。

paragraphs.en: Predictive representation quality and scale. Within predictive visual foundations (Table 4 ), we further examine how representation quality and encoder capacity affect downstream WAM learning. Upgrading from V-JEPA 2 to V-JEPA 2.1 consistently improves LIBERO-Plus robustness across both ViT-L and ViT-G scales, with larger gains under distribution shifts. In contrast, increasing encoder size from ViT-L to ViT-G primarily benefits in-distribution performance, while providing limited or even negative gains under LIBERO-Plus shifts. Notably, V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L achieves the strongest LIBERO-Plus performance despite using a smaller backbone than ViT-G. These results suggest that improvements in predictive representation learning are a more reliable path toward robust WAMs than scaling visual capacity alone with fixed downstream data.
paragraphs.zh: 预测表征的质量与规模。 在预测型视觉基础模型（表4）中，我们进一步考察表征质量与编码器容量如何影响下游世界_action模型（WAM）的学习。 从V-JEPA 2升级到V-JEPA 2.1，在ViT-L和ViT-G两种规模下都能持续提升LIBERO-Plus鲁棒性，且在分布偏移下提升更大。 相比之下，将编码器规模从ViT-L扩大到ViT-G主要有利于分布内性能，而在LIBERO-Plus偏移下收益有限甚至为负。 值得注意的是，V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L尽管使用了比ViT-G更小的骨干网络，却取得了最强的LIBERO-Plus性能。 这些结果表明，在下游数据固定的情况下，改进预测表征学习是获得鲁棒世界_action模型（WAM）的更可靠路径，而非仅靠扩大视觉容量。

paragraphs.en: Role of future prediction. We further isolate the role of explicit future-latent supervision from the contribution of the future-query pathway. With the visual foundation and downstream recipe fixed, we compare the full model against two ablations: a context-only variant that removes future queries, and a no-future-loss variant that retains the same future-query pathway but removes future-latent supervision. Both ablations degrade performance on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the no-future-loss variant failing to recover the full model despite preserving the future-query architecture. This indicates that the gains do not arise merely from expanding the predictor pathway, but from explicitly learning future visual representations that are coupled to downstream action generation. Detailed configurations and numerical results are provided in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 未来预测的作用。 我们进一步将显式的未来潜在表征监督的作用与未来查询通路的贡献分离开来。 在视觉基础与下游训练方案保持固定的情况下，我们将完整模型与两种消融变体进行比较：一种是移除未来查询的仅上下文变体，另一种是保留相同的未来查询通路但移除未来潜在表征监督的无未来损失变体。 两种消融变体在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 上的性能均出现下降，其中无未来损失变体尽管保留了未来查询架构，却仍无法恢复完整模型的性能。 这表明性能提升并非仅仅来自扩展预测器通路，而是来自显式学习与下游动作生成相耦合的未来视觉表征。 详细配置与数值结果见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether the same predictive latent space supports acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge, we pretrain only the instruction-conditioned predictor on DROID video–instruction pairs ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) using future-latent supervision. The visual encoder remains frozen, and pretraining involves neither action labels nor an action expert. We use the resulting weights to initialize the predictor for downstream joint training alongside a randomly initialized action expert.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究同一个预测性潜在空间是否能够支持学习可迁移的未来建模知识，我们仅在 DROID 视频–指令对（Khazatsky et al., 2024）上使用未来潜在监督对指令条件预测器进行预训练。 视觉编码器保持冻结，预训练既不涉及动作标签，也不涉及动作专家。 我们使用得到的权重来初始化预测器，用于下游的联合训练，同时搭配一个随机初始化的动作专家。

paragraphs.en: Transfer across benchmarks and distribution shifts. Under matched downstream protocols, predictor-only pretraining improves success across all three simulated benchmarks and both real-world tasks (Table 2 ). The improvement is modest on in-distribution LIBERO but substantially larger on LIBERO-Plus, where success rises from 79.25% to 91.50% without fine-tuning on perturbed demonstrations. Improvements are observed across all seven perturbation axes, with the largest gains under language, texture, and robot initial state shifts (Figure 2 (b)). Positive transfer to RoboCasa-GR1 and physical bimanual manipulation further indicates that future-modeling knowledge acquired without action supervision remains useful across robot embodiments.
paragraphs.zh: 跨基准测试与分布偏移的迁移能力。 在匹配的下游评估协议下，仅预测器预训练在所有三个仿真基准和两个真实世界任务上均提升了成功率（表 2）。 在分布内的 LIBERO 上提升幅度适中，但在 LIBERO-Plus 上提升显著更大——在未对扰动演示进行微调的情况下，成功率从 79.25% 提升至 91.50%。 改进体现在全部七个扰动维度上，其中在语言、纹理和机器人初始状态变化下增益最大（图 2(b)）。 向 RoboCasa-GR1 和物理双臂操作的积极迁移进一步表明，在无动作监督下习得的未来建模知识在不同机器人本体之间依然有用。

paragraphs.en: Transfer beyond downstream optimization. To test whether longer downstream training can recover the transfer gains, we extend a scratch run to 60k optimizer updates while keeping the model, dataset, and batch size fixed (Figure 2 (a)). Performance improves initially but shows diminishing gains later on both LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, remaining below the performance obtained with pretrained initialization. On LIBERO-Plus, pretrained initialization achieves 91.50% success rate (SR) after 10-epoch downstream updates, compared with 81.64% after 60k updates from scratch. Thus, additional task-specific optimization does not recover the gains from predictor pretraining along the evaluated training trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 超越下游优化的迁移能力。 为了测试更长时间的下游训练能否恢复迁移收益，我们在保持模型、数据集和批大小不变的情况下，将一次从零训练扩展到 6 万次优化器更新（图 2 (a)）。 性能起初有所提升，但在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 上后期增益递减，始终低于使用预训练初始化所获得的性能。 在 LIBERO-Plus 上，预训练初始化在经过 10 个 epoch 的下游更新后达到 91.50% 的成功率（SR），而从零训练 6 万次更新后仅为 81.64%。 因此，在所评估的训练轨迹上，额外的任务特定优化无法恢复来自预测器预训练的收益。

paragraphs.en: To address Q4 , we compare the deployment efficiency of V-JEPA Policy with those of FastWAM, a representative WAM, and other baselines. A key design choice of V-JEPA Policy is to perform future prediction in latent space: a single predictor forward pass produces the future-informed context interface used by the action expert, avoiding iterative visual generation at deployment. We benchmark the action-prediction core under a matched three-view setting on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with batch size 1, excluding sensor I/O and motor execution latency (as detailed in Appendix F ).

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 6 , V-JEPA Policy achieves a substantially smaller memory footprint among the evaluated WAMs, requiring only 4.66 GiB peak VRAM. Compared with FastWAM, which also avoids pixel-space decoding during deployment but retains a large visual generative backbone, V-JEPA Policy reduces peak memory usage by 63.4% and achieves lower inference latency (178.17 ms vs. 202.51 ms). These results show that predictive latent WAMs can preserve future-conditioned action generation while avoiding the deployment overhead associated with large generative visual models.

paragraphs.en: We showed that effective WAM learning can build on the latent space of a frozen predictive visual encoder without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generator. V-JEPA Policy instantiates this approach by jointly training a future predictor and an action expert from scratch, coupled through future-informed context states. The resulting compact policy achieves competitive simulation performance and supports real-world bimanual manipulation. Controlled encoder comparisons favor predictive visual latents, particularly under distribution shifts. Predictor-only pretraining on DROID video–instruction pairs without using action labels further improves downstream control and robustness, with LIBERO-Plus gains that extended scratch training does not recover within the evaluated budget. Together, these findings support predictive visual latents as a sufficient foundation for learning WAMs directly from task-specific demonstrations and acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge from broader video experience.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了有效的 WAM 学习可以建立在冻结的预测式视觉编码器的潜在空间之上，而无需继承一个完整的预训练视觉生成器。 V-JEPA Policy 通过从头联合训练一个未来预测器和一个动作专家来实现这一方法，二者通过包含未来信息的上下文状态相耦合。 由此得到的紧凑策略在仿真中取得了有竞争力的性能，并支持现实世界的双手操作。 受控的编码器对比实验表明预测式视觉潜在表征更具优势，尤其是在分布偏移的情况下。 仅在 DROID 视频–指令对上进行预测器预训练而不使用动作标签，进一步提升了下游控制能力与鲁棒性，其在 LIBERO-Plus 上的增益是在所评估的训练预算内延长从头训练所无法弥补的。 总之，这些发现支持将预测式视觉潜在表征作为直接从任务特定示范中学习 WAM 并从更广泛的视频经验中获取可迁移的未来建模知识的基础。

sents.en: We showed that effective WAM learning can build on the latent space of a frozen predictive visual encoder without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generator.
sents.zh: 我们证明了有效的 WAM 学习可以建立在冻结的预测式视觉编码器的潜在空间之上，而无需继承一个完整的预训练视觉生成器。

sents.en: V-JEPA Policy instantiates this approach by jointly training a future predictor and an action expert from scratch, coupled through future-informed context states.
sents.zh: V-JEPA Policy 通过从头联合训练一个未来预测器和一个动作专家来实现这一方法，二者通过包含未来信息的上下文状态相耦合。

sents.en: The resulting compact policy achieves competitive simulation performance and supports real-world bimanual manipulation.
sents.zh: 由此得到的紧凑策略在仿真中取得了有竞争力的性能，并支持现实世界的双手操作。

sents.en: Controlled encoder comparisons favor predictive visual latents, particularly under distribution shifts.
sents.zh: 受控的编码器对比实验表明预测式视觉潜在表征更具优势，尤其是在分布偏移的情况下。

sents.en: Predictor-only pretraining on DROID video–instruction pairs without using action labels further improves downstream control and robustness, with LIBERO-Plus gains that extended scratch training does not recover within the evaluated budget.
sents.zh: 仅在 DROID 视频–指令对上进行预测器预训练而不使用动作标签，进一步提升了下游控制能力与鲁棒性，其在 LIBERO-Plus 上的增益是在所评估的训练预算内延长从头训练所无法弥补的。

sents.en: Together, these findings support predictive visual latents as a sufficient foundation for learning WAMs directly from task-specific demonstrations and acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge from broader video experience.
sents.zh: 总之，这些发现支持将预测式视觉潜在表征作为直接从任务特定示范中学习 WAM 并从更广泛的视频经验中获取可迁移的未来建模知识的基础。

paragraphs.en: Training recipe. We keep the V-JEPA 2.1 visual encoder and T5-XXL text encoder frozen throughout training, and jointly optimize the future predictor and action expert on downstream tasks. We use AdamW with a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a linear warm-up over the first 5% of scheduled steps, and subsequent cosine decay. On LIBERO, we train jointly on the four suites for 21,360 optimizer steps, corresponding to ten epochs, with a global batch size of 128. The model uses two independently encoded 224 × 224 224\times 224 camera views and 32-step action chunks. On RoboCasa-GR1, we train on all 24 task datasets, each containing 1,000 episodes, for 50,000 steps with a global batch size of 256. The model uses a single 224 × 224 224\times 224 egocentric view and 16-step action chunks. For real-world experiments, we train a separate model for each of the two tasks using four camera views resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 . Both tasks use 32-step action chunks and a global batch size of 64, with 60,000 steps for Table Cleanup and 40,000 steps for Saucer Racking . For the pretrained-predictor variant, we first train only the future predictor on DROID for 100,000 steps with a global batch size of 192. This stage uses videos, language instructions, and proprioceptive states, without action labels or an action expert. We use two camera views resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 and ten-frame clips consisting of one context tubelet and four future tubelets. For downstream adaptation, we transfer only the pretrained predictor weights and initialize the action expert from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 训练方案。 我们在整个训练过程中保持 V-JEPA 2.1 视觉编码器和 T5-XXL 文本编码器冻结，并在下游任务上联合优化未来预测器与动作智能体。 我们使用 AdamW，峰值学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，在计划步骤的前 5% 进行线性预热，随后进行余弦衰减。 在 LIBERO 上，我们在四个任务套件上联合训练 21,360 个优化器步骤，对应十个 epoch，全局批大小为 128。 该模型使用两个独立编码的 224 × 224 224\times 224 相机视角和 32 步动作块。 在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，我们在全部 24 个任务数据集（每个包含 1,000 个回合）上训练 50,000 步，全局批大小为 256。 该模型使用单个 224 × 224 224\times 224 自我中心视角和 16 步动作块。 对于真实世界实验，我们为两个任务各训练一个单独的模型，使用四个相机视角并缩放至 256 × 256 256\times 256。 两个任务均使用 32 步动作块和 64 的全局批大小，其中 Table Cleanup 训练 60,000 步，Saucer Racking 训练 40,000 步。 对于预训练预测器变体，我们首先仅在 DROID 上训练未来预测器 100,000 步，全局批大小为 192。 该阶段使用视频、语言指令和本体感知状态，不使用动作标签或动作智能体。 我们使用两个缩放至 256 × 256 256\times 256 的相机视角，以及由一个上下文管状片段和四个未来管状片段组成的十帧片段。 对于下游适配，我们仅迁移预训练的预测器权重，并从头初始化动作智能体。

paragraphs.en: Task Suite and Success Criteria. We benchmark on two long-horizon, bimanual coordination tasks (Figure 4 ): (1) Table Cleanup : the left arm stows chopsticks into a holder while the right arm sweeps bowl contents into a trash bin, places the bowl in a drying rack, and discards a crumpled napkin; and (2) Saucer Racking : the right arm sweeps a saucer, transfers it to the left arm via bimanual handover for rack placement, and discards residual waste. Trials initialize from standardized robot rest poses with objects restored to canonical configurations under invariant illumination. Each rollout is strictly bounded by a 120 s execution cutoff from the first policy inference. A rollout is marked as a success only if all sequential substages are accomplished within the budget; timed-out trials are logged as 120 s failures.
paragraphs.zh: 任务套件与成功标准。 我们在两个长时程、双臂协调任务上进行基准测试（图4）：（1）桌面清理：左臂将筷子收进筷架，同时右臂将碗中的内容物扫入垃圾桶、把碗放到沥水架上，并丢弃一张揉皱的餐巾纸；（2）托盘上架：右臂将碟子扫拢，通过双臂交接把碟子转移到左臂以放入碗架，并丢弃残留的废弃物。 每次试验从标准化的机器人静止姿态开始，物体在恒定光照下恢复到规范构型。 每次推演严格受限于自首次策略推理起算的120秒执行截止时间。 只有当所有顺序子阶段都在时限内完成时，该次推演才被标记为成功；超时的试验被记录为120秒失败。

paragraphs.en: Fine-Tuning Scope and Hyperparameters. To reflect practical deployment, each method follows its native task-tuning schedule rather than an artificial compute-matched budget: V-JEPA Policy is fine-tuned with a batch size of 64 over 60k steps ( Table Cleanup ) and 40k steps ( Saucer Racking ), while baselines use a batch size of 32 over 100k and 40k steps, respectively. Consequently, real-world execution metrics benchmark practical deployed capability rather than strict sample efficiency parity.
paragraphs.zh: 微调范围与超参数。 为反映实际部署情况，每种方法均遵循其原生的任务微调计划，而非人为设定的算力匹配预算：V-JEPA Policy 以批大小 64 微调 6 万步（Table Cleanup）和 4 万步（Saucer Racking），而基线方法则以批大小 32 分别微调 10 万步和 4 万步。 因此，真实世界的执行指标衡量的是实际部署后的能力，而非严格的样本效率对等。

paragraphs.en: Comparison protocol. We compare frozen visual encoders using the same predictor and action-expert backbones, downstream demonstrations, global batch size of 128, and 21360 optimizer updates. The predictor and action expert are initialized from scratch, while the visual encoder remains frozen throughout downstream training. The evaluated foundations include discriminative features from DINOv2 and DINOv3, reconstructive latents from WAN2.2 VAE, video-understanding features from InternVideo3, and predictive features from V-JEPA 2 and V-JEPA 2.1. Within the predictive family, we compare both encoder generations at ViT-L and ViT-G scales.
paragraphs.zh: 对比协议。 我们在相同的预测器与动作专家骨干网络、相同的下游示范数据、128 的全局批量大小以及 21360 次优化器更新的条件下，对冻结的视觉编码器进行比较。 预测器和动作专家均从头初始化，而视觉编码器在整个下游训练过程中保持冻结。 评估的基础模型包括来自 DINOv2 和 DINOv3 的判别式特征、来自 WAN2.2 VAE 的重建式隐变量、来自 InternVideo3 的视频理解特征，以及来自 V-JEPA 2 和 V-JEPA 2.1 的预测式特征。 在预测式家族内部，我们在 ViT-L 和 ViT-G 两种规模上比较两代编码器。

sents.zh: 对比协议。

paragraphs.en: Latent interfaces. Each encoder provides observed-context representations and future prediction targets in its own latent space. Encoder-specific input and output projections accommodate differences in visual feature width while preserving the predictor’s Transformer backbone. The ViT-L variants of V-JEPA and DINO produce 1024-dimensional features, whereas WAN2.2 VAE and InternVideo3 produce 48- and 1152-dimensional features, respectively. The action-expert architecture is unchanged across configurations. Parameter counts in Table 4 include only the frozen visual encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在接口。 每个编码器在其自身的潜在空间中提供观测上下文表征和未来预测目标。 编码器专属的输入和输出投影可以适配视觉特征宽度的差异，同时保持预测器的 Transformer 主干不变。 V-JEPA 和 DINO 的 ViT-L 变体产生 1024 维特征，而 WAN2.2 VAE 和 InternVideo3 分别产生 48 维和 1152 维特征。 动作专家架构在各配置中保持不变。 表 4 中的参数量仅包含冻结的视觉编码器。

paragraphs.en: Input alignment. Following Sec. 5.3 , we adjust spatial resolution and frame sampling within the same raw video segments to match the spatial patch grid and temporal token length across encoders, separately for observed context and future targets. For DINOv2 ViT-L/14, images are resized to 196 × 196 196\times 196 , yielding a 14 × 14 14\times 14 patch grid. This matches the grid produced by V-JEPA ViT-L with 224 × 224 224\times 224 inputs and 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches. For WAN2.2 VAE, we subsample the input video frames with a temporal stride of two before encoding. Action labels and chunk lengths remain identical across encoder configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 输入对齐。 按照 5.3 节，我们在相同的原始视频片段内调整空间分辨率和帧采样，以匹配不同编码器之间的空间 patch 网格和时间 token 长度，观测上下文和未来目标分别处理。 对于 DINOv2 ViT-L/14，图像被缩放至 196 × 196 196\times 196，得到 14 × 14 14\times 14 的 patch 网格。 这与 V-JEPA ViT-L 在 224 × 224 224\times 224 输入和 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch 下产生的网格相匹配。 对于 WAN2.2 VAE，我们在编码前以时间步长为二对输入视频帧进行下采样。 动作标签和 chunk 长度在各编码器配置中保持一致。

sents.zh: 输入对齐。

paragraphs.en: We keep the frozen visual encoder, downstream data, training seed, batch size, update count, and action-chunk configuration fixed. The context-only control omits future queries and conditions the action expert on context-only predictor features. The no-future-loss control retains the full future-query pathway and sets the future-latent loss weight to zero. All configurations retain action supervision. Future queries in the no-future-loss control remain trainable and receive gradients through the action objective.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保持冻结的视觉编码器、下游数据、训练种子、批大小、更新次数以及动作块配置不变。 仅上下文对照组省略未来查询，并使动作专家仅以上下文预测器特征为条件。 无未来损失对照组保留完整的未来查询通路，并将未来潜变量损失的权重设为零。 所有配置均保留动作监督。 无未来损失对照组中的未来查询保持可训练状态，并通过动作目标接收梯度。

sents.en: We keep the frozen visual encoder, downstream data, training seed, batch size, update count, and action-chunk configuration fixed.
sents.zh: 我们保持冻结的视觉编码器、下游数据、训练种子、批大小、更新次数以及动作块配置不变。

sents.en: The context-only control omits future queries and conditions the action expert on context-only predictor features.
sents.zh: 仅上下文对照组省略未来查询，并使动作专家仅以上下文预测器特征为条件。

sents.en: The no-future-loss control retains the full future-query pathway and sets the future-latent loss weight to zero.
sents.zh: 无未来损失对照组保留完整的未来查询通路，并将未来潜变量损失的权重设为零。

sents.en: All configurations retain action supervision.
sents.zh: 所有配置均保留动作监督。

sents.en: Future queries in the no-future-loss control remain trainable and receive gradients through the action objective.
sents.zh: 无未来损失对照组中的未来查询保持可训练状态，并通过动作目标接收梯度。

paragraphs.en: The full model outperforms both controls on both benchmarks. The comparison with the no-future-loss control supports the contribution of explicit future-latent supervision while keeping the query architecture fixed. The context-only control evaluates the necessity of the future-query pathway, whereas the no-future-loss control isolates the effect of explicit predictive supervision while preserving the pathway.
paragraphs.zh: 完整模型在两个基准测试上均优于两个对照模型。 与无未来损失对照的比较表明，在保持查询架构不变的情况下，显式的未来潜在变量监督有其贡献。 仅上下文对照评估未来查询通路的必要性，而无未来损失对照则在保留该通路的情况下，单独考察显式预测监督的作用。

sents.en: The full model outperforms both controls on both benchmarks.
sents.zh: 完整模型在两个基准测试上均优于两个对照模型。

paragraphs.en: Predictor-only pretraining. We pretrain the instruction-conditioned predictor on DROID robot video–instruction pairs ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) using the future-latent regression objective in Eq. 7 . Demonstrations are temporally subsampled from 15 Hz to 5 Hz, using one exterior camera and one wrist camera. For each view, a training clip contains two observed frames and eight future frames. With a temporal tubelet size of two, these correspond to one context and four future temporal tubelet positions per view. The predictor is additionally conditioned on the observed proprioceptive state and cached T5 instruction features. The visual and text encoders remain frozen, and no action expert or action-label supervision is used during pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: 仅预测器预训练。 我们在 DROID 机器人视频–指令对（Khazatsky et al., 2024）上，使用公式 7 中的未来潜变量回归目标，对指令条件化的预测器进行预训练。 演示数据在时间上从 15 Hz 下采样到 5 Hz，使用一个外部相机和一个腕部相机。 对于每个视角，一个训练片段包含两帧观测帧和八帧未来帧。 在时间 tubelet 大小为 2 的情况下，这些对应于每个视角一个上下文时间 tubelet 位置和四个未来时间 tubelet 位置。 预测器还以观测到的本体感知状态和缓存的 T5 指令特征作为条件。 视觉和文本编码器保持冻结，且在预训练期间不使用动作专家或动作标签监督。

sents.zh: 仅预测器预训练。

sents.zh: 演示数据在时间上从 15 Hz 下采样到 5 Hz，使用一个外部相机和一个腕部相机。

sents.zh: 对于每个视角，一个训练片段包含两帧观测帧和八帧未来帧。

sents.zh: 预测器还以观测到的本体感知状态和缓存的 T5 指令特征作为条件。

paragraphs.en: We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 2 10^{-2} , and ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) . Pretraining runs for 100,000 optimizer updates on eight GPUs with a global batch size of 192 and BF16 precision. The learning rate follows a 5,000-update linear warmup and cosine decay over the remaining 95,000 updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 AdamW，学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，权重衰减为 10 − 2 10^{-2}，且 ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) 。预训练在八块 GPU 上以 192 的全局批次大小和 BF16 精度进行 100,000 次优化器更新。学习率遵循 5,000 次更新的线性预热，并在其余 95,000 次更新中采用余弦衰减。

paragraphs.en: Downstream transfer. The pretrained predictor initializes downstream WAM learning, while the action expert is initialized from scratch. Both modules are then jointly optimized with the objective in Eq. 9 , with the visual and text encoders kept frozen. For each downstream benchmark or task, the scratch and DROID-initialized models use identical demonstrations, batch sizes, optimizer settings, and numbers of updates. The action expert is initialized from scratch in both settings; the predictor initialization is the only change.
paragraphs.zh: 下游迁移。 预训练预测器用于初始化下游 WAM 学习，而动作专家则从头开始初始化。 随后，两个模块按照式 9 中的目标进行联合优化，视觉编码器和文本编码器保持冻结。 对于每个下游基准或任务，从头初始化的模型与 DROID 初始化的模型使用完全相同的演示数据、批量大小、优化器设置和更新次数。 两种设置中动作专家均从头开始初始化；唯一的区别是预测器的初始化方式。

sents.zh: 下游迁移。

paragraphs.en: On LIBERO, both models use a global batch size of 128 and 21360 optimizer updates. The resulting checkpoints are evaluated directly on LIBERO-Plus without further fine-tuning. On RoboCasa-GR1, both models use a batch size of 256 and 50000 optimizer updates, without gradient accumulation. The same matched-protocol comparison is used for the real-world tasks. Predictor pretraining adds an upstream training stage; the matched budgets refer to downstream training, not total training computation.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarking Setup and Boundary Conditions. Latency and memory profiles are measured on a dedicated local workstation equipped with a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU (batch size 1). To isolate representation and model architectures from external hardware and pipeline variation, each model receives identical synthetic inputs matching our three-view setup (head, left wrist, right wrist). Measurements are gathered across 3 independent OS processes per architecture; each process executes 10 warmup iterations followed by 100 recorded calls, yielding 300 timed runs in total with background telemetry disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试设置与边界条件。 延迟与内存性能数据在一台配备单块 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 的专用本地工作站上测得（批大小为 1）。 为了将表示与模型架构同外部硬件和流水线差异隔离开来，每个模型接收与我们的三视角设置（头部、左手腕、右手腕）相匹配的相同合成输入。 每种架构的数据采集横跨 3 个独立的操作系统进程；每个进程执行 10 次预热迭代后进行 100 次记录调用，最终共得到 300 次计时运行，且禁用了后台遥测。

sents.en: Benchmarking Setup and Boundary Conditions.
sents.zh: 基准测试设置与边界条件。

sents.en: Latency and memory profiles are measured on a dedicated local workstation equipped with a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU (batch size 1).

sents.en: To isolate representation and model architectures from external hardware and pipeline variation, each model receives identical synthetic inputs matching our three-view setup (head, left wrist, right wrist).

sents.en: Measurements are gathered across 3 independent OS processes per architecture; each process executes 10 warmup iterations followed by 100 recorded calls, yielding 300 timed runs in total with background telemetry disabled.
sents.zh: 每种架构的数据采集横跨 3 个独立的操作系统进程；每个进程执行 10 次预热迭代后进行 100 次记录调用，最终共得到 300 次计时运行，且禁用了后台遥测。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, this protocol isolates the action-prediction inference and explicitly factors out pipeline overheads: (1) I/O and preprocessing : camera RTSP acquisition, image decoding, resizing, and host-to-device transfers; (2) Control and post-processing : inter-process IPC, action denormalization, temporal ensembling queue updates, and One-Euro filtering; and (3) Actuator communication : network packet serialization and low-level motor bus latency.
paragraphs.zh: 至关重要的是，该协议将动作预测推理隔离出来，并明确分解出流水线开销：(1) I/O 与预处理：摄像头 RTSP 采集、图像解码、缩放以及主机到设备的传输；(2) 控制与后处理：进程间 IPC、动作反归一化、时序集成队列更新以及 One-Euro 滤波；(3) 执行器通信：网络数据包序列化和底层电机总线延迟。

paragraphs.en: Implementation Alignment. Two adaptations ensure rigorous comparability across disparate model repositories: First, for FastWAM, generated action tensors are retained directly in GPU memory, bypassing native CPU synchronization and serialization overheads. Second, because the full PRTS and V-JEPA Policy checkpoints were trained on four camera streams, our benchmarked computation graphs retain the head and bimanual wrist embeddings while adapting the input sequence to three views, leaving all model weights untouched. Because the scratch and DROID-initialized V-JEPA Policy variants execute an identical computation graph, we report a single structural profile (Table 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 实现对齐。 两项适配确保了跨不同模型仓库的严格可比性：其一，对于 FastWAM，生成的动作张量直接保留在 GPU 内存中，从而绕过了原生的 CPU 同步与序列化开销。 其二，由于完整的 PRTS 和 V-JEPA Policy 检查点是在四路相机流上训练的，我们的基准测试计算图在保留头部和双手腕部嵌入的同时，将输入序列调整为三个视角，且未改动任何模型权重。 由于从头训练与 DROID 初始化的 V-JEPA Policy 变体执行完全相同的计算图，我们报告单一的结构特征（表 10）。

paragraphs.en: The base V-JEPA Policy lies on the empirical Pareto frontier in all five settings among the compared methods. On LIBERO, it achieves 97.25% success, 1.15 percentage points below ImageWAM’s 98.4% while using one-fifth of its parameters. On RoboCasa-GR1, it achieves 50.92% success with 0.9B parameters, compared with 47.60% for the 3.0B GR00T N1.6. On the real-world tasks, it achieves 55% success on Table Cleanup and 35% on Saucer Racking; the latter matches FastWAM with 15% of its parameter count. These comparisons further demonstrate that predictive visual latents provide a foundation for effective WAM learning at a compact policy scale.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有五种设置中，基础 V-JEPA 策略在所比较的方法中均位于经验帕累托前沿上。 在 LIBERO 上，它达到 97.25% 的成功率，比 ImageWAM 的 98.4% 低 1.15 个百分点，而参数量仅为其五分之一。 在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，它以 0.9B 参数达到 50.92% 的成功率，而 3.0B 的 GR00T N1.6 为 47.60%。 在真实世界任务上，它在 Table Cleanup 上达到 55% 的成功率，在 Saucer Racking 上达到 35%；后者以 15% 的参数量追平了 FastWAM。 这些比较进一步表明，预测性视觉潜变量为在紧凑策略规模下进行有效的 WAM 学习提供了基础。
